paper_title: Spectrum of global string networks and the axion dark matter mass
coupling_convention: m_a in eV (prediction, not a limit)
notes: This is a theoretical/numerical simulation paper predicting the post-inflationary QCD axion dark matter mass in the range m_a = 95-450 ueV from global string network simulations. It is a PREDICTION of the axion mass, not an experimental exclusion limit or sensitivity projection on a coupling. No (mass, coupling) exclusion data points are presented; the main result is a range on m_a itself. Not an extractable exclusion limit in the standard sense. | [CONVENTION REVIEW] declared coupling convention 'm_a in eV (prediction, not a limit)' is not canonical and has no vetted auto-conversion; needs human review
